title: DORA Register of Information xBRL-CSV Validator
description: Field-level pre-submission validator for the annual DORA Register of Information xBRL-CSV package (report.json, FilingIndicators.csv, parameters.csv, archive filename, table CSVs) against the EBA DPM 4.0 filing rules documented in the CSSF NCA submission guide. Checks package format and field discipline, not the register's business content. Client-side. Zero PII.

archiveFilename.description: Proposed archive filename, checked against the LEI.IND|CON_Country_Version_ReferenceDate_Timestamp.zip naming convention

rules.description: Rule-by-rule PASS/WARN/FAIL verdicts with clause citations

mcp_tool_definition.name: validate_dora_roi_xbrl_csv_package
mcp_tool_definition.description: Validates a prepared DORA Register of Information xBRL-CSV package (report.json, FilingIndicators.csv, parameters.csv, archive filename, table CSVs) against the EBA DPM 4.0 filing rules documented in the CSSF NCA submission guide: exact report.json documentType/extends content, lowercase FilingIndicators booleans, parameters.csv field order and decimalsMonetary=-3, archive naming convention, and representative per-table mandatory-column and LEI-format/checksum checks. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII, zero network (no GLEIF lookup). Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/633-dora-roi-xbrl-csv-validator.html for interactive use.
